tokens.interpretation: Token t0 marks the tens digit position in addition problems, regardless of carry state or sum value.
This token routes to the fourth digit position during addition when a carry from the previous position must be incorporated.
Token t2 outputs the ones digit (0) when adding two numbers whose ones digits sum to 10 or more.
Token t3 routes to the hundreds position (d3) when processing carries from the tens column in addition.
Token t4 routes to positions where the sum of digits equals zero, typically when a carry must be processed.
Token t5 routes cases where the ones digit result is 0, spanning multiple subtasks and operations.
Token t6 routes cases where the ones digit result is 0, regardless of operation or carry state.
Token t7 routes to positions where the result digit is 0, regardless of operation or carry state.
Token t8 activates when processing the tens digit (d2) across addition/subtraction with various carry/borrow states.
Token t9 routes to subtraction positions with borrow cascades, especially when result digit is zero.
Token t10 routes subtraction problems requiring borrow propagation at mid-to-late digit positions.
Token t11 routes subtraction problems at the thousands position when borrowing is needed or absent.
Token t12 fires when computing digit sums that equal 0 modulo 10, particularly at position d0.
Token t13 identifies positions where the sum of two digits equals 9 modulo 10.
Token t14 routes subtraction problems involving borrow operations, particularly cascading borrows.
Token t15 routes to addition/subtraction positions requiring carry/borrow handling when sum mod 10 is 7 or 2.
Token t16 routes when processing carry-dependent digit positions in addition and subtraction.
Token t17 marks positions requiring borrow handling in subtraction, especially with cascading borrows.
Token t18 routes to borrow cascade (UD) and borrow-making (MB) subtasks in subtraction columns.
Token t19 routes to addition problems at position d1 that must propagate a carry from the ones place.
Token t20 routes subtraction problems with borrows, especially at positions d2-d4.
Token t21 routes to cascade subtraction steps where a borrow propagates through multiple digits.
Token t22 routes early addition positions (d4) with no carry input, regardless of sum output.
